The code uses CONFIG.waveSeconds, and a message that mentions a setting builds it from CONFIG ("You start with " + CONFIG.startCoins + " coins"), so changing the setting changes the message too. The block under them is api.getBlock(Math.floor(x), Math.floor(y) - 1, Math.floor(z)).\n- A player who can't play any more (e.g. out of lives): api.setPlayerGamemode(playerId, "spectator"); "survival" brings them back.\n- Mob waves: api.attemptSpawnMob(mobType, x, y, z) returns the mob's id. Keep the ids, and remove each in onMobDespawned(mobId) to know when they are all dead.\n- Removing or changing a block later: count ms in tick, then api.setBlock(x, y, z, "Air").\n- Coins as a currency: make it once in onPlayerJoin, only if they don't have it yet (a saved one comes back by itself, and setCurrency again would reset it): if (api.getCurrencyAmount(playerId, "coins") === null) api.setCurrency(playerId, "coins", { amount: 0, icon: "coins" }).
